brief.headline: Push for 15-day faster payment in exchange for a modest price cut on caps — we're ₹27.42 L/year with them, their finances aren't public, so line up a second source and negotiate from choice.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price cut to ₹0.65–0.80/pc on PP caps at higher volume or looser spec
priceAsk.basis: Open-market asking price for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc; the market verdict is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — so we have room to push down

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move payment from 45 days to 30 days in exchange for the price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Switching to 30 days frees up ₹2.25 L of our cash; going 15 days faster (to 30 days) unlocks ₹1.13 L for us

brief.financialLeverage: This supplier publishes no financials — we can't see their revenue, profit, or how tight their cash is. We spend ₹27.42 L/year with them, but without knowing their size we can't gauge how much we matter to them. That means we build our ask from the market data (the ₹0.65–0.80 band) and from having real second sources ready. The plan is to push for the better price and faster payment, but not so hard that we're flying blind — which is why lining up an alternate now is critical.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, covering pharma bottles and caps — a strong, qualified second source with health score B (65/100)

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader at ₹1010.97 Cr revenue, strong and profitable (health B, 73/100) — proven in pharma pails, containers, bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited
alternates.why: A manufacturer lead found in market research (confidence Medium, India-Pan) — qualify before issuing an RFQ, but a credible maker-level option

risks: We have no visibility into their finances — if they're fragile, a hard squeeze could backfire; keep the tone firm but not punishing.
The market-ask data shows modest headroom (₹0.65–0.80) only at higher volume or looser spec — confirm our volume and spec before committing to that target.
Reliance and the other marketBackups are leads to qualify (verify capability and get quotes) — don't treat them as approved alternates yet.
Switching payment to 30 days saves us ₹2.25 L but costs them cash they may need — tie it clearly to the price cut so it feels like a trade, not a squeeze.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹27.42 L a year with you on caps and want to grow that — but we need you at ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume and 30-day payment to make the business case work for both of us.
